# license family

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/licenseFamily>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The family a licence belongs to — one of the [`gmeow:LicenseFamily`](../classes/gmeow-LicenseFamily.md) values. Functional.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) -> [`gmeow:LicenseFamily`](../classes/gmeow-LicenseFamily.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md) from [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) to [`gmeow:LicenseFamily`](../classes/gmeow-LicenseFamily.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a licence into its family — public-domain, Creative Commons, permissive, copyleft, proprietary, or dual — for coarse-grained filtering and policy decisions.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as the precise licence identity (that is [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md)) and avoid a free-text family; reference a [`gmeow:LicenseFamily`](../classes/gmeow-LicenseFamily.md) value, which mirrors but never duplicates the config.py import policy.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md) once per [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:LicenseFamily`](../classes/gmeow-LicenseFamily.md) value alongside the precise [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md).

### Examples

- ex:gplLicense [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md) [`gmeow:licenseFamilyCopyleft`](../individuals/gmeow-licenseFamilyCopyleft.md).
